peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 13.2% above its local comparables; 114 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.4): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 251 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 12). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $4,080,000 ($2,774 psf, 1,442–1,550 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,451 psf (range $2,046–2,798); 13.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $475,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Katong MRT about 100 m, Marine Parade MRT about 930 m; closer than 639 of 662 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 840 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 630 m), more than 177 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 1,090 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area B about 170 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 510 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 680 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 740 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 840 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 930 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,320 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,370 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,460 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 284 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 471 new sales and 578 resales (1,049 purchases); new sales were 44.9% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,940 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 578 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 152 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 578 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 664 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
